services.name: Tropical Sunset Boat Cruise
services.desc: Our newest family friendly boat cruise is a step in a different direction. Come Join us on The Lola and experience the enchanting beauty of Oahu's coastline with the Tropical Sunset Cruise. Embark on a 1.5-hour journey that combines the breathtaking colors of a Hawaiian sunset with the freedom to dip into the crystal-clear waters. As you sail along the picturesque shores, immerse yourself in the serenity of the moment, accompanied by a carefully curated selection of mellow music that enhances the tranquil ambiance. With this cruise the entire family can see the best views of Waikiki and an Experience the enchanting beauty of Oahu's coastline

services.name: Snorkel Tour
services.desc: Watch Oahu's sea life from a closer glance while swimming through schools of tropical fish. Observe the abundant amount of large green sea turtles that visit the shallower turtle cleaning station known as Turtle Canyons. The Honolulu Snorkel Co. Crew is made up of certified divers, lifeguards, free divers, and surfers, who are all experts in these waters. They can show you where to look and what to look for. Highlights Brand new vessel. "The Lola" Top-of-the-line snorkel gear Beverages and snacks included Floatation devices 2 Hour Tour
